_comment: ngsolve thermal_structural#4 (symbolic-zero RHS: LinearForm(0*v*dx) has no TestFunction). Verified 2026-08-03 on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh=0.3, H1(order=2, dirichlet='left|right'). LinearForm(0*vT*dx).Assemble() raises NgException whose str() is exactly 'Linearform must have TestFunction'. A 1e-30 coefficient assembles fine, so the collapse is symbolic (the literal 0) and not a smallness threshold. The no-integrand constructor LinearForm(V); f.Assemble() yields an all-zero vector that still carries the template's pure-conduction solve to T_max = 100 after Dirichlet lifting.
